newsitem.title: SPAIN: BoS has reason to cut key rate on Friday-BBV.
newsitem.headline: BoS has reason to cut key rate on Friday-BBV.

text.p: After tame February consumer price data the Bank of Spain could be prompted to reduce its six percent key money market rate, Banco Bilbao Vizcaya (BBV) said in a brokers note on Thursday.
"The Bank of Spain has reasons to cut the official rate at tomorrow's (repo) auction," the statement said.
BBV added that February CPI, which fell 0.1 percent from January to 2.5 percent year-on-year, was better than expected.
